summary: Iter 22 — broad regression for Improvements widget, admin Posts/Admins panels, Back-to-Feed pill, and is_user_admin() refactor. Backend: 31 passed, 1 skipped (no second env admin to exercise the 'cannot demote env admin' branch). Frontend: floating Suggest works anonymously, modal submits successfully, back-to-feed hides on /feed and on anonymous routes, shows on every other authed page, mobile uses compact 'FEED' label. Improvements admin panel renders items with correct count badge and supports status transitions + delete. Posts panel filters + take-down buttons render (no hidden posts existed). Admins panel: env admin badge + 'Locked via env' label correctly suppresses demote; promote/demote round-trip on user_dana_demo verified end-to-end (toast confirmed). All 14 admin tabs visible. ONE gap found: floating Suggest + Back-to-Feed are NOT rendered on the /news/* aggregator section because /news uses AggLayout, not Layout — spec required Suggest 'on every screen'.

ui_bugs.issue: FloatingSuggestButton and BackToFeedButton are NOT mounted in AggLayout. As a result, anonymous visit to /news shows no Suggest pill, and signed-in users on any /news/* page have no Back-to-Feed pill. Spec stated 'Suggest button visible on every screen' and 'Back-to-feed on EVERY page when signed in'. Fix: add <BackToFeedButton /> and <FloatingSuggestButton /> to AggLayout (mirroring lines 179 + 181 of Layout.jsx).

action_items: Add <BackToFeedButton /> + <FloatingSuggestButton /> to /app/frontend/src/components/AggLayout.jsx so the floating CTAs appear on the /news/* aggregator routes. This is the only spec deviation found.
critical_code_review_comments: improvements.py auth flow uses HTTPException catch inside _maybe_user to silently degrade to anonymous — good pattern. ALLOWED_STATUSES check is duplicated on both POST and PATCH paths; consistent.

admin_users.py: search excludes status='needs_application' which is sensible but env admins whose user row was never created won't appear in the list. Not blocking — they're locked via env anyway and can't be demoted.
admin_posts.py: snippet truncation does not strip markdown / HTML; long-form essays may show raw markdown in the admin row. Acceptable for an admin-only triage view but worth a future polish pass.

FloatingSuggestButton/BackToFeedButton are only wired into Layout, not AggLayout — this is the source of the /news gap reported above. If a future page introduces yet another wrapper, the same gap will recur. Consider hoisting these two floats into App.js once, outside the layout wrapper, so route layout choice can't strip them.

success_rate.backend: 100% (31/31 executed; 1 skipped is environment-bound, not a failure)
success_rate.frontend: 94% (13/14 flows pass; 1 gap on /news layout missing the floating buttons)

context_for_next_testing_agent: AggLayout is a sibling layout used for /news/* routes — when adding global UI affordances (Back-to-Feed, Suggest, etc.) they need to be wired into BOTH Layout.jsx and AggLayout.jsx, or hoisted up to App.js outside ChromeLayout. The is_user_admin() refactor passed full regression: env admin and runtime-promoted admin both authorize correctly on /api/admin/flags, /api/admin/orphan-profiles, /api/applications?status=pending, /api/admin/email/readiness (note: actual path is /api/admin/email/readiness, NOT /api/admin/email-health/readiness as the request stated), /api/admin/improvements, /api/admin/users/search, /api/admin/posts/recent. Test data is cleaned up; the demo users user_dana_demo / user_sarah_demo / user_marcus_demo are non-env admins useful for promote/demote testing.
rca_of_the_issue: Floating Suggest gap on /news/*: App.js (lines 53, 67) routes any path matching /^\/news(\/|$)/ through AggLayout instead of Layout. Layout.jsx renders <BackToFeedButton /> and <FloatingSuggestButton /> at lines 179 and 181, but AggLayout.jsx does not import or render them. Reproduction: visit https://thn-community.preview.emergentagent.com/news anonymously — bottom-left has no Suggest pill. Mitigation: copy the two imports + render calls from Layout.jsx into AggLayout.jsx, OR hoist these two components into App.js outside ChromeLayout so route-specific layouts cannot strip them.
